positive_snippets: Everything was fantastic! The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. The room service and food were both excellent.

Had a wonderful stay! The front office team was very polite, professional, and always ready to help. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Food quality was great, and the staff throughout the hotel were courteous and attentive. Overall, a very pleasant experience — truly worth recommending.
It is a good property with lawn. Rooms are big enough. However, WiF  connection is poor in many rooms.
negative_snippets: It is a good property with lawn. Rooms are big enough. However, WiF  connection is poor in many rooms. Location is not well lit and missing sign boards. In view if this, it is difficult to locate during night drive.

I went to meet a friend there, approach road to the hotel is little tricky.. and there is only one gate for entry/exit. Didn't see many guests staying there. Room price seemed to be on higher side. I feel many better options are available in the same cost.
